item.title: Norway arrests three brothers over US embassy bombing in Oslo
item.summary: Norway police on Wednesday said they had arrested three brothers suspected of a "terrorist bombing" outside the US Embassy in Oslo that caused minor damage but no injuries, as investigators probed possible motives including links to Iran.
